title: Vampire Vape Vlads VG Loser 10ml
description: Loser from Vampire Vape’s Vlads collection is an absolute winner in our opinion and a tantalising treat for the senses that’s bursting with tropical sunshine! Waves of mouth-watering, tangy Pineapple mingle with deliciously fresh, juicy and sweet Mango for a sun-soaked taste of exotic destinations. Vampire Vapes’ new Vlads VG collection assembles some of the most iconic e-liquid flavours to come out of the legendary vape makers labs, and makes them available in high-VG, 10ml bottles. The collection includes such famous flavours as Heisenberg and Pinkman, as well as newer additions like Blue Gun, Loser and Attraction Fatal. Vampire Vapes’ Vlads VG e-liquids contain a 70VG/30PG ratio that makes them ideal for use in vape kits that use sub-ohm coils, as well as being easy to travel with. These kits include advanced vape kits as well as pod kits and refillable pods that use coils with a resistance of 0.8ohm or lower. Their High-VG content provides a deeply flavoursome experience with a smooth, comfortable throat hit and clouds of satisfying vaper! Based in Manchester, England Vampire Vape are one of the most popular and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. The company has won international renown for the quality and variety of their e-liquids, and for their signature flavours including such game-changing e-liquid icons as Heisenberg and Pinkman flavours.
